_: What the window's card geometry must measure in the captures the docs show.
Read by tooling/check-geometry, which runs anywhere -- it needs the committed
PNGs and Pillow, not a Mac and a build. docs/UI-SPEC.md is the prose; these are
the numbers, in capture pixels, which for these captures are DIPs 1:1.
card_band is the span used to recognise a gutter: a run of rows (or columns)
that are window ground all the way across the card. Probing one pixel would
depend on what the page is showing; a band does not.
Captures list only the edges that are actually visible in them. ui-welcome has
the welcome flow over the card's left edge and corner, and ui-current and
ui-spaces have page content running to the bottom of the card, so those edges
are not measurable there and are not claimed.
